title: Production Quality Assurance Specialist - Incoming Quality
description:
Drive and coordinate Quality Control activities for Incoming Inspection are to ensure zero shop complaints and to improve in overall inspection processes.
   

  

**Your Role**
* Knowledge about basic EHS guidelines/Environmental aspect and Risk related to inspection activities on Machines and during Assembly
* Knowledge about Risk related to chemical management related to Nondestructive testing and able to interpret MSDS related to associated chemicals.
* Initiate /support different environmental projects related to 3R’s (reduce/reuse/recycle).
* Report all Incidents / Accidents / Events / Spill / Leak as per the organization requirement.
* In depth knowledge about Machining and Assembly process preferably from Steam Turbine Manufacturing Processes
* Well conversant for using of Measuring instrument like Vernier Caliper, Micrometer, Bore Gauges etc..
* In\-depth knowledge about the Steam Turbine manufacturing process and quality requirements
* Able to read and interpret Engineering drawing and geometrical tolerances requirement
* Able to detect any counter fraudulent inspection report received from Supplier or during inspection of bought out items
* Review of Supplier documentation/EOMR
* Raise flag for any non\-conformance/process deviations
* Hands on experience on QM Module of SAP
* Well convergent with manufacturing process like Machining, Assembly and Fabrication of Steam Turbine Components
* Create awareness among team to raise stop work/Quality Concern on small deviations
* Able to communicate on deviation with the sourcing/supplier/supplier quality.
* Preparation of Visual inspection reports
* Carryout “C” class component inspection and prepare dimension inspection report.
* Work as a bridge between shop quality team and sourcing quality team.
* Monitor Issues identified during shop and work with sourcing to improve the process at supplier end.


**Basic Qualifications(requirements)**
* Diploma/B.E/Btech in Mechanical Engineering.
* 5\-7 Years of Experience in incoming Quality.
* Well convergent with SAP/MTA/Microsoft Office tools (Advance understanding needed)


**Desired Qualifications**
* NDT Level II in LPT/MPT as per ASNT.


 Join us and work with global teams to support global customers ! At Arabelle Solutions, we have team members of more than 49 nationalities spread across 16 countries.
   

  

 At Arabelle Solutions, we know diversity makes teams and business stronger.
